digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and repair-pause coordination across CI providers
propositions: The bridge entrypoint must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged Python runner without repository-local scripts
Destructive-repair pause ownership must use a provider-neutral durable git-based gate mechanism that does not depend on GitHub CLI or other provider-specific tools
Legacy reconcile workflows invoking rebar reconcile --mode and checked-out environments must retain their behavior, exit codes, defaults, and published messaging unchanged
The repair-pause mechanism must read existing pause snapshots, enforce schedule safety through set_pause, and release only observed OIDs via ref-lock coordination without automatic retry reclaim

Both the runner-neutral bridge entrypoint and provider-neutral destructive-repair implementations must preserve all existing CLI signatures and mutation boundaries while adding new noun-based bridge routes
No new unauthenticated or boundary-crossing surfaces are introduced; the portability is achieved through internal refactoring of existing reconciler and repair logic
